blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 54 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed a comprehensive project for a 54 m² apartment, including interior design and technical documentation, custom furniture manufacturing, turnkey renovation and final decoration.

The project covers all the main functional areas of the apartment: living room, bedroom, kitchen with carefully planned storage and built-in appliances, dressing areas, entrance hall and bathroom. Custom wardrobes, shelving and integrated storage systems were also incorporated into the interior.

Custom-made furniture solutions were designed and manufactured for each area, taking into account the dimensions and specific characteristics of the rooms. Developing the interior and furniture as one integrated concept makes it possible to use the available floor area efficiently, provide practical storage and maintain a consistent visual style throughout the apartment.

The project was implemented as a comprehensive process — from the development of the interior concept and technical documentation to renovation works, custom furniture manufacturing and installation, and professional interior decoration. Before construction began, a detailed estimate was prepared covering renovation works, finishing materials, custom furniture and household appliances.
The project is presented through photorealistic 3D visualizations, demonstrating the layout, interior concept and custom furniture solutions developed for the 54 m² apartment.
